Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_PlaybackDuration_t: Maximum normal-CD playback time measured in game minutes. If the native CD program ends early, it repeats until this limit. Manual Stop always ends playback immediately.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_ReduceBoredom_tool: Reduces Boredom once per game minute while an ordinary CD is audibly playing through powered headphones. Applies to every ordinary CD, including repeats. This switch controls the additional effect; vanilla media rewards remain. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_ReduceUnhappiness_: Reduces Unhappiness once per game minute while an ordinary CD is audibly playing through powered headphones. Applies to every ordinary CD, including repeats. This switch controls the additional effect; vanilla media rewards remain. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_ReduceStress_toolt: Reduces Stress once per game minute while an ordinary CD is audibly playing through powered headphones. Applies to every ordinary CD, including repeats. This switch controls the additional effect; vanilla media rewards remain. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_ReducePanic_toolti: Reduces Panic once per game minute while an ordinary CD is audibly playing through powered headphones. Applies to every ordinary CD, including repeats. This switch controls the additional effect; vanilla media rewards remain. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_ReduceAnger_toolti: Reduces Anger once per game minute while an ordinary CD is audibly playing through powered headphones. Applies to every ordinary CD, including repeats. This switch controls the additional effect; vanilla media rewards remain. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_SkillXP_tooltip: Controls the erased-CD skill system. Recording requires a blank CD in the player, installed headphones, and a carried microphone. A recorded song restores through Play with installed headphones.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_RecordTimeMultipli: Scales recording time. At 1.0, the skill-only workload and vanilla time scaling match Personal Journal writing.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_RestoreTimeMultipl: Scales recovery time. At 1.0, the skill-only workload uses the same vanilla reading-duration path as Personal Journal recovery.
Sandbox_SurvivorsSong_RecoveryPercent_to: Percentage of the XP stored in a recorded song that can be restored. Recovery only fills missing XP and never lowers current skills.
